scope: Peer-reviewed and accepted work on routing across external language models. Findings, industry tracks, and workshops are labeled explicitly.

papers.title: Hybrid LLM: Cost-Efficient and Quality-Aware Query Routing
papers.summary: Routes each query between small and large models using estimated difficulty and a tunable quality target.

papers.title: Routing to the Expert: Efficient Reward-guided Ensemble of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Distills reward signals into a lightweight router for selecting among specialized language models.

papers.title: OrchestraLLM: Efficient Orchestration of Language Models for Dialogue State Tracking
papers.summary: Uses domain-aware routing between specialized and general models for dialogue state tracking.

papers.title: Large Language Model Routing with Benchmark Datasets
papers.summary: Introduces a benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for cost-quality model routing.

papers.title: RouterDC: Query-Based Router by Dual Contrastive Learning for Assembling Large Language Models
papers.summary: Learns aligned query and model representations through dual contrastive objectives.

papers.title: Smoothie: Label Free Language Model Routing
papers.summary: Infers model quality from agreement structure in output embeddings without labeled routing data.

papers.title: AutoMix: Automatically Mixing Language Models
papers.summary: Uses self-verification and a partially observable decision process to escalate difficult queries.

papers.title: Efficient Contextual LLM Cascades through Budget-Constrained Policy Learning
papers.summary: Jointly selects models and prompting strategies under explicit monetary and latency budgets.

papers.title: Harnessing the Power of Multiple Minds: Lessons Learned from LLM Routing
papers.summary: Reports negative results and evaluation lessons that challenge optimistic router assumptions.

papers.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs from Preference Data
papers.summary: Learns cost-quality routing policies from human preference comparisons between model outputs.

papers.title: GraphRouter: A Graph-based Router for LLM Selections
papers.summary: Models relationships among queries, tasks, and candidate models as a graph for generalizable selection.

papers.title: EmbedLLM: Learning Compact Representations of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Learns reusable model embeddings for routing and performance forecasting across benchmarks.

papers.title: BEST-Route: Adaptive LLM Routing with Test-Time Optimal Compute
papers.summary: Allocates test-time compute across models according to query difficulty and resource constraints.

papers.title: Learning to Route LLMs with Confidence Tokens
papers.summary: Trains models to expose confidence tokens that support routing, escalation, and rejection.

papers.title: A Unified Approach to Routing and Cascading for LLMs
papers.summary: Places one-shot routing and sequential cascades inside a common decision-theoretic framework.

papers.title: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Selects collaboration topology, agent roles, and model backbones for multi-agent workloads.

papers.title: IRT-Router: A Learning-to-Rank Framework for LLM Routing
papers.summary: Uses item-response-theory signals to estimate query difficulty and rank candidate models.

papers.title: MixLLM: Dynamic Routing in Mixed Large Language Models
papers.summary: Applies contextual bandits to a model pool whose composition and feedback change over time.

papers.title: RouterEval: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Routing LLMs
papers.summary: Evaluates routers across heterogeneous tasks, model pools, cost assumptions, and routing methods.

papers.title: Adaptive LLM Routing under Budget Constraints
papers.summary: Combines an offline preference prior with online contextual-bandit updates under a budget.

papers.title: RadialRouter: Structured Representations for Generalizable LLM Routing
papers.summary: Structures query and model representations to improve generalization as the model pool changes.

papers.title: Select-then-Route: Taxonomy Guided Routing for LLMs
papers.summary: First narrows the candidate pool using a task taxonomy, then applies a routing cascade.

papers.title: Rerouting LLM Routers
papers.summary: Shows that adversarial gadget strings can manipulate router control flow and model selection.

papers.title: Cost-Aware Contrastive Routing for LLMs
papers.summary: Learns shared query-model embeddings and cost bands for routing through dynamic model pools.

papers.title: Causal LLM Routing: End-to-End Regret Minimization from Observational Data
papers.summary: Learns routing policies from logged, partial observational feedback rather than a full score matrix.

papers.title: Efficient Training-Free Online Routing for High-Volume Multi-LLM Serving
papers.summary: Provides training-free online routing with approximate retrieval and serving-scale guarantees.

papers.title: Let the LLM Stick to Its Strengths: Learning to Route Economical LLM
papers.summary: Frames model routing as recommendation to handle heterogeneous capabilities and unseen models.

papers.title: RAGRouter: Learning to Route Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
papers.summary: Adds retrieved evidence to the routing signal instead of selecting from the user query alone.

papers.title: Principled Model Routing for Unknown Mixtures of Source Domains
papers.summary: Connects routing to domain adaptation and studies guarantees under unknown source mixtures.

papers.title: MESS+: Dynamically Learned Inference-Time LLM Routing in Model Zoos with Service Level Guarantees
papers.summary: Learns routing online while enforcing service-level targets across a heterogeneous model zoo.

papers.title: Router-R1: Teaching LLMs Multi-Round Routing and Aggregation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Trains an agentic router to iteratively select, query, and aggregate multiple models.

papers.title: Universal Model Routing for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.summary: Learns transferable correctness representations that support routing across changing model pools.

papers.title: DiSRouter: Distributed Self-Routing for LLM Selections
papers.summary: Replaces a single central router with a network of models that expose their own capability signals.

papers.title: Meta-Router: Bridging Gold-standard and Preference-based Evaluations in LLM Routing
papers.summary: Corrects bias between preference feedback and gold-standard task evaluation for router training.

papers.title: RADAR: Reasoning-Ability and Difficulty-Aware Routing for Reasoning LLMs
papers.summary: Jointly selects a reasoning model and reasoning budget using ability and difficulty estimates.

papers.title: TRIM: Hybrid Inference via Targeted Stepwise Routing in Multi-Step Reasoning Tasks
papers.summary: Routes individual reasoning steps between models using process-level quality signals.

papers.title: Routing, Cascades, and User Choice for LLMs
papers.summary: Studies routing as a strategic interaction between providers, routing policies, and user choice.

papers.title: Breaking Model Lock-in: Universal Routing for Dynamic LLM Pools
papers.summary: Supports zero-shot onboarding of new models through a universal latent capability space.

papers.title: ICL-Router: In-Context Learning for Dynamic LLM Routing
papers.summary: Builds model representations in context so a router can incorporate new models with little retraining.

papers.title: CP-Router: Conformal Prediction for Reliable LLM Routing
papers.summary: Uses conformal uncertainty to decide when workloads require a stronger reasoning model.

papers.title: Online Multi-LLM Selection via Contextual Bandits Under Unstructured Context Evolution
papers.summary: Learns sequential model choices online as unstructured workload context evolves.

papers.title: PRISM: Privacy-Aware Routing for Adaptive Cloud–Edge LLM Inference
papers.summary: Selects local, cloud, or collaborative paths while treating privacy as a routing objective.

papers.title: How Robust Are Router-LLMs?
papers.summary: Evaluates privacy leakage, safety failures, adversarial examples, and backdoors in learned routers.

papers.title: SEMIROUTER: Sparse-Data Enhanced Routing for Large Language Models
papers.summary: Improves routing when labeled model-query performance observations are sparse.

papers.title: TRouter: Task-Aware LLM Routing with Multi-Level Task-Profile-Guided Data Synthesis for Cold-Start Scenarios
papers.summary: Synthesizes task-profile data to improve routing when real observations are scarce.

papers.title: FLARE: Fine-Grained Length-Aware Routing for Resource-Efficient Heterogeneous LLM Serving
papers.summary: Uses generation length and serving cost to route across heterogeneous model deployments.

papers.title: EvoRoute: Experience-Driven Self-Routing LLM Agent Systems
papers.summary: Lets agent systems improve routing decisions from accumulated execution experience.

papers.title: RouteMoA: Dynamic Routing without Pre-Inference Boosts Efficient Mixture-of-Agents
papers.summary: Selects agent collaboration paths without requiring expensive model probing before inference.

papers.title: MTRouter: Multi-Turn LLM Routing with Conversation-Aware Decisions
papers.summary: Uses conversation history and temporal signals rather than routing each turn independently.

papers.title: ATLAS: Orchestrating Heterogeneous Models and Tools
papers.summary: Extends model routing into joint orchestration across models, tools, and execution paths.

papers.title: LLMRouterBench: A Unified Benchmark for Large Language Model Routing
papers.summary: Standardizes router comparison across tasks, candidate pools, objectives, and evaluation assumptions.

papers.title: R2-Router: Efficient and Interpretable Large Language Model Routing
papers.summary: Learns efficient routing decisions with interpretable signals over query and model capabilities.

papers.title: RouterArena: Benchmarking and Understanding LLM Routing
papers.summary: Provides a common arena for comparing routing algorithms over shared prediction and evaluation protocols.

papers.title: BOute: Cost-Efficient LLM Serving with Heterogeneous LLMs and GPUs via Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.summary: Co-optimizes query routing and model placement across heterogeneous models and accelerators.

papers.title: FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing
papers.summary: Routes to complementary subsets of models instead of treating selection as a single-winner decision.

papers.title: vLLM Semantic Router: Signal Driven Decision Routing for Mixture-of-Modality Models
papers.summary: Composes heterogeneous workload signals into inspectable routing policies across cost, privacy, latency, and safety constraints.

papers.title: The Workload-Router-Pool Architecture for LLM Inference Optimization: A Vision Paper from the vLLM Semantic Router Project
papers.summary: Frames inference optimization as co-design across semantic workload demand, routing decisions, and the live model-and-hardware pool.

papers.title: Visual Confused Deputy: Exploiting and Defending Perception Failures in Computer-Using Agents
papers.summary: Formalizes perception-induced unsafe action in computer-use agents and evaluates a dual-channel guardrail over target perception and action reasoning.

papers.title: Outcome-Aware Tool Selection for Semantic Routers: Latency-Constrained Learning Without LLM Inference
papers.summary: Learns outcome-aware tool ranking offline while keeping serving-time semantic routing within a single-digit-millisecond CPU budget.

papers.title: Adaptive Vision-Language Model Routing for Computer Use Agents
papers.summary: Estimates each computer-use action's difficulty and routes it to the least expensive vision-language model that meets a reliability target.

papers.title: 98× Faster LLM Routing Without a Dedicated GPU: Flash Attention, Prompt Compression, and Near-Streaming for the vLLM Semantic Router
papers.summary: Combines attention, prompt-compression, and request-streaming optimizations so routing can share serving hardware instead of requiring a dedicated GPU.

papers.title: inference-fleet-sim: A Queueing-Theory-Grounded Fleet Capacity Planner for LLM Inference
papers.summary: Uses queueing models and discrete-event simulation to size multi-pool inference fleets against tail-latency objectives.

papers.title: FleetOpt: Analytical Fleet Provisioning for LLM Inference with Compress-and-Route as Implementation Mechanism
papers.summary: Derives a minimum-cost two-pool fleet from workload and tail-latency constraints, then makes the operating boundary deployable through compress-and-route.

papers.title: The 1/W Law: An Analytical Study of Context-Length Routing Topology and GPU Generation Gains for LLM Inference Energy Efficiency
papers.summary: Models how context-window growth changes inference energy efficiency and motivates context-length-aware routing across serving pools.

papers.title: Conflict-Free Policy Languages for Probabilistic ML Predicates: A Framework and Case Study with the Semantic Router DSL
papers.summary: Detects and prevents overlapping probabilistic predicates so declarative routing policies remain deterministic and auditable.

papers.title: From Inference Routing to Agent Orchestration: Declarative Policy Compilation with Cross-Layer Verification
papers.summary: Compiles one policy source into verified decision nodes across agent workflows, serving infrastructure, and protocol boundaries.

papers.title: Knowledge Access Beats Model Size: Memory Augmented Routing for Persistent AI Agents
papers.summary: Routes persistent user queries through memory and retrieval before model escalation, treating knowledge access as a first-class routing signal.

papers.title: Fast and Faithful: Real-Time Verification for Long-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
papers.summary: Evaluates low-latency verification for long-context RAG, an adjacent reliability signal that can gate or reroute generated answers.

papers.title: Token-Budget-Aware Pool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Inference
papers.summary: Predicts request token budgets and dispatches traffic across short- and long-context pools to reduce cost while avoiding KV-cache failures.

papers.title: When to Reason: Semantic Router for vLLM
papers.summary: Classifies whether a request benefits from explicit reasoning and activates the more expensive reasoning path only when needed.

papers.title: Category-Aware Semantic Caching for Heterogeneous LLM Workloads
papers.summary: Adapts similarity thresholds, retention, and cache quotas to semantic workload classes instead of applying one cache policy globally.

papers.title: Semantic Inference Routing Protocol (SIRP)
papers.summary: Specifies content-level classification and semantic routing signals as an interoperable inference-routing protocol framework.

papers.title: Multi-Provider Extensions for Agentic AI Inference APIs
papers.summary: Defines API extensions for selecting and coordinating inference providers in agentic systems across administrative boundaries.
